name: Laravel 12 + Livewire 3 + PostgreSQL
note: Each task runs a real command. No token figures are recorded here; evals/runner.py measures context cost directly from the kit files. The suite runs against SQLite in-memory (DB_CONNECTION=sqlite, DB_DATABASE=:memory: in phpunit.xml) so no PostgreSQL service is required. Not exercised: AUTH-02 (the kit ships no login component), DATA-01 (no query-building code beyond plain Eloquent) and CI-01/02 (pipeline gates). LW-01 tests Livewire's own checksum and is not mutation-checkable from kit code.

eval_tasks.title: Application installs and boots
eval_tasks.instruction: Composer dependencies must resolve and the Laravel application must bootstrap far enough to list its routes.

eval_tasks.title: Feature behaviour
eval_tasks.instruction: The kit's feature tests must pass.
assertions: a signed-in user can create a task through the Livewire component

eval_tasks.title: Declared security controls hold under test
eval_tasks.instruction: Run the suite that exercises the controls named in security/checks.json. Each test is mutation-verified where the control lives in kit code: removing the control makes the test fail.
assertions: LW-01 a tampered Livewire snapshot is rejected
LW-02 toggle and delete are policy-authorized; guests and other users get 403; the list is scoped to the owner
LW-03 owner is not client-writable; priority restricted to low/medium/high
LW-04 title and description lengths validated
LW-05 mutating actions throttled at 30 per minute per user
AUTH-01 argon2id hashing, AUTH-03 session cookie flags

eval_tasks.title: Full suite green
eval_tasks.instruction: The complete suite must pass with no failures.
